title: Geometry of Continued Fractions — Further open questions
exact_target: Does the classical Jacobi--Perron algorithm eventually repeat for every independent basis triple of a totally real cubic field with the two nonconstant entries between zero and one?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1900020 (AMR-018-0020). CC BY 4.0.
Oleg Karpenkov, \emph{Open problems in geometry of continued fractions}, 2017. Problem 20 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
Oleg Karpenkov, \emph{On Hermite's problem, Jacobi--Perron type algorithms, and Dirichlet groups}, arXiv:2101.12707, 2021. Section 2.1, pp. 5--7, algorithm and Problem 1 (Jacobi's Last Theorem).
